summary: Inspected src/metric-spaces/indexed-sums-metric-spaces.lagda.md (11282 bytes). This file contains substantive formal mathematics: it defines the indexed sum (coproduct) of a family of metric spaces over a set, constructs the neighborhood relation, proves all required metric space axioms (reflexive, symmetric, triangular, saturated), establishes tightness/extensionality, and proves two key properties — that the projection is locally constant and each fiber embedding is an isometry. The file is literate Agda with executable definitions, statements, and proofs throughout.
